page_title: OVI 1-0 SEV | Oviedo v Sevilla 05/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Sevilla was in an offside position.
90+2' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90+2' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick goes way wide to the right. Poor shot!
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Eric Bailly (Real Oviedo) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
89' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) for his blatant foul.
88' Oviedo exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.

86' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Javi Lopez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo).
82' 6:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
80' Problems for Luis Garcia Plaza as Ruben Vargas is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) replaces him.
79' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
77' The resulting corner from Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) is cleared by the defence.

76' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Odysseas Vlachodimos makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
74' Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
73' Here is a change. Oso is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla).
72' Today's match ends for Thiago Fernandez who will be replaced by Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo).
72' Substitution. Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) on for Alberto Reina.
71' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box.
69' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Oviedo.

67' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
66' The corner from Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) is intercepted by the defence.
65' The attendance for today's match is 24921.
64' One of the Oviedo players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Sevilla have a free kick.
62' Sevilla are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
59' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to make a change. Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) replaces Kwasi Sibo.
59' Substitution. Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo) replaces Federico Vinas.
58' 72:28 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
56' Castrin (Sevilla) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
54' Kike Salas (Sevilla) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
53' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
52' Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Odysseas Vlachodimos intercepts the ball.
50' Chance! Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
49' Dani Calvo (Real Oviedo) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
49' The ball goes out of play. Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
48' Sevilla are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
48' That will be all from Batista Mendy who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Isaac Romero (Sevilla).
46' Half-time substitution. Luis Garcia Plaza decided to make a change. Djibril Sow is replaced by Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla).
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jose Angel Carmona departs the field of play to be replaced by Castrin (Sevilla).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
45+4' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
45+2' Akor Adams (Sevilla) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Oviedo fail to score from a corner as Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla) leaps to collect the ball.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Oviedo, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
38' Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) takes out his opponent with an awful tackle and is shown a red card by the referee!
37' Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Sevilla force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
36' Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
35' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:3.

32' 1 - 0 Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:0.
32' Now Oviedo have a corner.
31' A spell of possession for Oviedo in an attempt to control the game.
29' A dangerous towering header by Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
29' The ball is out of play and Sevilla manage to earn a corner.
26' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
25' The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Eric Bailly (Real Oviedo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:1.
18' Oviedo keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
16' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
15' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
11' 77:23 – the ratio of ball possession.
9' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) takes a short corner kick.
7' Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
6' Akor Adams (Sevilla) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
5' One of the Oviedo players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
3' Oviedo are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
